name: Cabincore
summary: Cabincore is an aesthetic that romanticizes the life of residing in a cabin.
description: Cabincore is an aesthetic that romanticizes the life of residing in a cabin. Similar to Cottagecore , Naturecore , Earthcore , Campcore , and Adventurecore , Cabincore embraces the idea of getting away from bustling industrial life, favoring places where days can be spent in a more remote setting. The aesthetic features a rustic, relaxing, warm cabin theme.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Getting away from it all., Closeness and appreciation to nature, all while sitting back, observing, and reflecting on life.

visualDNA.colour: Deep browns , auburn. Darker shades of red, maroon, burgundy, etc. All shades of green , white , burnt orange

fashion.Overview: Since Cabincore is associated heavily with being calm and relaxed, cozy clothes are a staple.
fashion.Tops: Cozy Sweaters; Flannels; Warm, thick coats.; Vests; Jackets (denim, corduroy, down, etc.)
fashion.Bottoms: Jeans; Overalls; Corduroy Trousers; Wool Skirts
fashion.Footwear: Warm socks - Smartwools and fuzzy socks; Slippers; Hiking/work boots, timberlands, docs, suede boots and rainboots; Birkenstocks, Crocs
fashion.Accessories: Watches; Thick Belts; Small, plain jewelry; Carabiners, multitools; Lanyards, keychains; Beanies, brimmed hats, baseball caps; Gloves
fashion.Fabrics/Textiles: Wool; Corduroy; Leather; Denim; Flannel; Chunky Knits
fashion.Hairstyles: Braided Styles; Messy buns; Curly; Ponytails; Pretty much anything, especially if functional

activities: Embroidery while listening to your favorite music
Lighting cozy candles and watching the rain
